RASA — 3D Hero Concept

These are static mockups (SVG/CSS) previewing lighting, composition and per-collection material direction — this canvas can't run real WebGL. The metal/copper tone stays constant across all three collections (matches the real --majlis-accent / --makhmal-accent / --tarkib-accent tokens, all #D3A188); only the background wash + pattern differ per collection.

Engineering handoff: implement with @react-three/drei ScrollControls driving camera position against a real GLB hookah model. Asset options: commission a 3D artist from the hero-hookah.jpg/hookah-luxury.jpg references, license + retexture a close match in Blender, or a fast procedurally-lathed placeholder. Compress with Draco/Meshopt — target under ~2MB per model.
